optionsEn: he is NOT “healthy”, because his mental and social well-being are impaired — health is more than the absence of disease
emotional and social problems are unrelated to health
one is unhealthy only once a disease actually appears
he is fully healthy because the physical examination found no disease
hmh_co_1.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
世界衞生組織（WHO）對「健康」的定義是身體、心理及社會三方面的完全安寧，而不僅是沒有疾病。一名長者身體檢查一切正常，但喪偶後長期獨居、與社會脫節、情緒低落。按整全健康觀，最準確的判斷是？
hmh_co_1.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The WHO defines health as complete physical, mental and social well-being, not merely the absence of disease. An elderly man is physically healthy on examination, but after losing his spouse he lives alone, is socially isolated and low in mood. On the holistic view of health, the most accurate judgement is that?
hmh_co_1.explanation:
整全（holistic）健康觀涵蓋身、心、社三方面：此長者雖無生理疾病，但情緒低落（心理）與社會脫節（社會）已損及其安寧，故按 WHO 定義並非健康。這正是「健康 ≠ 沒有疾病」的關鍵。

【陷阱】「身體無病即完全健康」把健康窄化為生理層面；「情緒社交與健康無關」「患病才算不健康」均否定了心理與社會維度。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmh_co_1.explanationEn:
The holistic view spans physical, mental and social dimensions: though free of physical disease, his low mood (mental) and isolation (social) impair his well-being, so by the WHO definition he is not healthy. This is the crux of “health ≠ absence of disease.”

【Trap】 “No physical disease = fully healthy” narrows health to the physical; “emotions/social unrelated to health” and “unhealthy only once ill” deny the mental and social dimensions.

【陷阱】「純身體」「與健康無關」「只屬經濟」都看漏了社交參與對健康社會維度的作用。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmh_co_2.explanationEn:
Interest groups rebuild connection and participation, addressing the social dimension of health; holistic care attends to physical, mental and social (even spiritual) needs, not just disease.

【Trap】 “Purely physical”, “unrelated to health” and “purely economic” all miss the role of social participation in the social dimension of health.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

復康治療＝一級；疫苗＝三級；篩查＝三級
三者全部屬於一級預防

rehabilitation = primary; vaccination = tertiary; screening = tertiary
cancer screening = primary; vaccination = secondary; health education = tertiary
hmh_pv_3.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
公共衞生把預防分為三級：一級（疾病發生前的預防）、二級（早期偵測與治療）、三級（減低已患病者的併發與失能）。下列哪一組「措施—級別」配對完全正確？
hmh_pv_3.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Public health distinguishes three levels of prevention: primary (before disease occurs), secondary (early detection and treatment), tertiary (limiting complications and disability in those already ill). Which pairing of measure-to-level is entirely correct?
hmh_pv_3.explanation:
一級預防在「疾病發生前」阻止其出現（疫苗、健康教育）；二級在「早期」偵測並治療（篩查）；三級在「已患病後」減少併發與失能（復康）。故正確配對為疫苗／教育＝一級、篩查＝二級、復康＝三級。

【陷阱】其餘各項把篩查、疫苗、復康的級別對調或一概歸入一級，皆混淆了「病前／早期／病後」這條時間軸。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmh_pv_3.explanationEn:
Primary prevention stops disease before it occurs (vaccines, health education); secondary detects and treats it early (screening); tertiary limits complications and disability after disease (rehabilitation). So vaccine/education = primary, screening = secondary, rehab = tertiary.

【Trap】 The others swap or lump the levels, confusing the before/early/after timeline.

健康差異純屬隨機，沒有任何成因

that the health gap is purely random with no causes
that personal habits are actually irrelevant to health
hmh_et_4.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
兩個收入、教育與居住環境差異很大的社區，健康狀況也明顯不同。把這種差異「全部」歸咎於個人生活習慣（如不運動、飲食差），主要忽略了？
hmh_et_4.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Two communities differing greatly in income, education and housing also differ markedly in health. Blaming this difference ENTIRELY on individual lifestyle (e.g. lack of exercise, poor diet) mainly overlooks?
hmh_et_4.explanation:
把健康不平等全歸於個人選擇，忽略了「社會決定因素」：低收入、低教育、惡劣居住與醫療可及性差等結構條件，本身就限制了人的健康與其能作的選擇。整全的分析須兼顧個人與社會因素。

【陷阱】「習慣與健康無關」走向另一極端；「純屬隨機」「只有基因」都否定了社會結構因素的系統性影響。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmh_et_4.explanationEn:
Blaming health inequality wholly on individual choice ignores the social determinants of health: low income, low education, poor housing and weak access to care are structural conditions that themselves constrain health and the choices people can make. A holistic analysis weighs both individual and social factors.

【Trap】 “Habits irrelevant” over-corrects; “purely random” and “only genes” deny the systematic influence of social structure.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 保密原則（及尊重自主）——未經同意披露個人敏感資料，損害服務使用者的私隱與自決
沒有違反任何照顧倫理原則
行善原則，因為這樣做幫助了鄰居

hmh_et_5.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名照顧者未經服務使用者同意，便把對方的病歷與私人情況告訴鄰居。從照顧倫理看，這主要違反了哪一原則？
hmh_et_5.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A carer tells a neighbour about a service user’s medical history and private circumstances without consent. In care ethics, this mainly violates which principle?
hmh_et_5.explanation:
未經同意披露服務使用者的病歷與私事，直接違反「保密原則」，亦不尊重其自主與私隱。照顧關係建立於信任，保密是專業倫理的基石。

【陷阱】「行善」「公平」是張冠李戴——把侵犯私隱說成助人或人人該知；「沒有違反」更是錯認。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmh_et_5.explanationEn:
Disclosing a user’s medical history and private matters without consent directly violates confidentiality and disrespects their autonomy and privacy. Care relationships rest on trust, and confidentiality is a cornerstone of professional ethics.

【Trap】 “Beneficence”/“fairness” misapply principles — recasting a privacy breach as helping or a right to know; “no violation” simply misreads it.

在疾病早期階段及早發現並治療

optionsEn: reducing the risk of disease before it occurs
providing palliative care for terminally ill patients
detecting and treating disease at an early stage

hm_floor_01.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
公共衞生的「一級預防」，其主要目標是甚麼？
hm_floor_01.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What is the main aim of primary prevention in public health?
hm_floor_01.explanation:
三級預防按「疾病進程的哪一個階段」劃分。一級預防在疾病尚未發生時介入，目的是減低風險，例子有接種疫苗、健康教育、改善環境衞生。二級預防針對已經開始但尚未顯現症狀的疾病，透過篩查及早發現並治療。三級預防針對已確診的病人，目標是減少併發症與失能，例如中風後的康復治療。紓緩照顧一般歸入三級預防的範疇。分辨的關鍵不在於措施本身，而在於介入時病人處於哪一個階段——同一項措施用於不同對象，可以屬於不同級別。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_01.explanationEn:
The three levels are defined by the stage of the disease process at which they act. Primary prevention intervenes before disease occurs and aims to reduce risk, as with vaccination, health education and improved environmental hygiene. Secondary prevention targets disease that has begun but is not yet symptomatic, using screening to detect and treat it early. Tertiary prevention applies to diagnosed patients and aims to limit complications and disability, as in rehabilitation after a stroke; palliative care is generally placed here as well. The distinguishing factor is not the measure itself but the stage the person is at — the same measure applied to different people can fall under different levels.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 及早偵測尚未出現症狀的疾病
消除令人患病的環境風險因素
訓練已失能人士恢復生活自理
制訂全民適用的健康政策方針
optionsEn: removing environmental risk factors for disease
training disabled people to regain independence
drawing up health policy for the whole population
hm_floor_02.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
「二級預防」的核心工作是甚麼？
hm_floor_02.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What is the core activity of secondary prevention?
hm_floor_02.explanation:
二級預防的重點是「早」——疾病其實已經開始，但病人自己未察覺，透過篩查在症狀出現之前發現它，此時治療的效果通常最好。常見例子有子宮頸細胞檢查、大腸癌篩查、定期血壓與血糖檢查。消除環境風險因素是在疾病未開始時介入，屬一級預防；訓練失能人士恢復自理是在確診之後，屬三級預防；制訂全民健康政策則多屬一級預防的層面。留意二級預防的前提是該疾病有一段可偵測而未有症狀的時期，並且早治療確實比遲治療有效——不符合這兩個條件的疾病，大規模篩查未必有益。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_02.explanationEn:
Secondary prevention is about earliness: the disease has in fact begun but the person is unaware of it, and screening finds it before symptoms appear, when treatment usually works best. Common examples are cervical smear tests, bowel cancer screening, and regular blood pressure and glucose checks. Removing environmental risk factors acts before disease begins and is primary prevention; training disabled people to regain independence comes after diagnosis and is tertiary; drawing up population-wide health policy generally sits at the primary level. Note that secondary prevention presupposes a detectable pre-symptomatic phase and that earlier treatment genuinely helps — for diseases meeting neither condition, mass screening may not be beneficial.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

optionsEn: not a form of prevention at all
hm_floor_03.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
為長期臥床的病人定時翻身、預防褥瘡，屬於哪一級預防？
hm_floor_03.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Turning a bedridden patient regularly to prevent pressure sores is which level of prevention?
hm_floor_03.explanation:
病人已經確診並且長期臥床，介入的目的是減少因臥床而引致的併發症與進一步失能，因此屬三級預防。這一條容易答錯，是因為「預防褥瘡」四字之中有「預防」二字，令人直覺歸入一級。但判斷級別要看服務對象處於疾病進程的哪一階段，而不是看措施名稱有沒有「預防」。同一道理：為健康人士推廣運動是一級，為已確診糖尿病人做足部護理以防截肢是三級。答題時先問一句「這個人現在算病了沒有」，再決定級別，比記例子清單可靠。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_03.explanationEn:
The patient is already diagnosed and bedridden, and the intervention aims to reduce complications and further disability arising from that condition, so it is tertiary prevention. This question is easy to get wrong because the word prevention appears in the phrase preventing pressure sores, which invites the answer primary. But the level is determined by where the person sits in the disease process, not by whether the measure is called prevention. By the same logic, promoting exercise among healthy people is primary, while foot care for a diagnosed diabetic to avoid amputation is tertiary. Asking first whether this person is currently ill is more reliable than memorising a list of examples.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hm_floor_04.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
衞生署為初生嬰兒安排接種疫苗，屬於哪一級預防？
hm_floor_04.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The Department of Health arranging vaccination for newborns is which level of prevention?
hm_floor_04.explanation:
接種對象是尚未患病的嬰兒，目的是令他們日後不會感染該疾病，即在疾病發生之前就把風險降低，屬典型的一級預防。要留意疫苗與篩查的分別：疫苗改變的是「會不會病」，篩查改變的是「幾時發現」，前者屬一級，後者屬二級。另外，即使疫苗保護率並非百分之百，仍然屬一級預防——級別的判定看介入的時機與目的，並不取決於成效的高低。這一點在答比較題時值得指出，可以顯示對分類原則的理解而非死記例子。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_04.explanationEn:
The recipients are infants who are not yet ill, and the aim is that they should not contract the disease later — reducing risk before disease occurs, which is textbook primary prevention. Note the distinction between vaccination and screening: a vaccine changes whether you fall ill, while screening changes when it is found; the former is primary, the latter secondary. Note too that a vaccine remains primary prevention even though its protection is not total — the level depends on the timing and purpose of the intervention, not on how effective it is. Making this point in a comparison question shows an understanding of the classifying principle rather than memorised examples.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hm_floor_05.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
政府為五十歲以上市民提供免費大腸癌篩查，屬於哪一級預防？
hm_floor_05.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A government programme offering free bowel cancer screening to people over 50 is which level of prevention?
hm_floor_05.explanation:
篩查的對象是沒有症狀的市民，目的是在病變未引起不適之前把它找出來，及早處理，這正是二級預防的定義。有學生會因為「參加篩查的人未病」而答一級，但一級預防要改變的是患病的風險本身，例如改善飲食或戒煙；篩查並不降低患癌的機會，它只令發現的時間提前。這個分別在答題時要講清楚：一級改變「會不會發生」，二級改變「幾時發現」，三級改變「發生之後有多嚴重」。三句話可以貫穿整個課題。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_05.explanationEn:
Screening is offered to people without symptoms, and its purpose is to find changes before they cause discomfort so they can be dealt with early — precisely the definition of secondary prevention. Some students answer primary because participants are not yet ill, but primary prevention alters the risk of disease itself, through measures such as better diet or stopping smoking; screening does not lower the chance of developing cancer, it only brings forward the moment of detection. This distinction should be stated explicitly in an answer: primary changes whether it happens, secondary changes when it is found, tertiary changes how severe it becomes. Those three phrases cover the whole topic.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 康復治療不屬預防範疇
hm_floor_06.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
物理治療師為中風後的病人進行步行訓練，協助他重新自行外出，屬於哪一級預防？
hm_floor_06.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A physiotherapist giving gait training to a patient after a stroke, so that they can go out unaided again, is which level of prevention?
hm_floor_06.explanation:
病人已經中風，介入的目標是減少殘留的失能、提升自理與生活質素，屬三級預防。康復治療經常被誤以為「不算預防」，但三級預防所預防的並非疾病本身，而是疾病帶來的失能與依賴——這正是它與一、二級的分別所在。從整全健康的角度看，這一項介入同時觸及身體（行動能力）與社交（能否外出與人接觸）兩個層面，答論述題時把兩者一併指出，比只寫「幫助康復」更能取分。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_06.explanationEn:
The patient has already had a stroke, and the aim is to reduce residual disability and improve independence and quality of life, making this tertiary prevention. Rehabilitation is often mistakenly thought not to count as prevention, but what tertiary prevention prevents is not the disease itself — it is the disability and dependence the disease brings, which is exactly what distinguishes it from the first two levels. Seen through holistic health, this intervention touches both the physical dimension (mobility) and the social one (being able to go out and meet people), and pointing to both earns more marks in an essay than simply writing that it aids recovery.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 同時包含一級與二級預防的元素
純粹屬於二級預防，並無其他元素
三個預防級別的元素都沒有涉及
純粹屬於一級預防，並無其他元素
optionsEn: it contains both primary and secondary elements
it is purely secondary prevention and nothing else
it involves none of the three prevention levels
it is purely primary prevention and nothing else
hm_floor_07.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
在中學推行禁煙教育，同時為已吸煙的學生提供戒煙輔導。就三級預防而言，這項計劃的性質是甚麼？
hm_floor_07.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A secondary school runs anti-smoking education while also offering cessation counselling to students who already smoke. In terms of levels of prevention, what is the nature of this programme?
hm_floor_07.explanation:
同一項計劃可以橫跨多於一個級別，判斷時要按服務對象分開來看。對未吸煙的學生而言，禁煙教育是在行為未開始前降低風險，屬一級預防；對已吸煙的學生而言，戒煙輔導是在健康損害尚未明顯之際及早介入，減低日後患病的機會，一般歸入二級預防的範疇。這一條的用意是打破「一項措施只對應一個級別」的直覺——實際的公共衞生計劃大多是多層並行的。答題時應先分清對象，再逐一判定級別，而不是為整個計劃硬套一個標籤。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_07.explanationEn:
A single programme can span more than one level, and the way to judge it is to separate the groups it serves. For students who do not smoke, anti-smoking education lowers risk before the behaviour begins, which is primary prevention. For those who already smoke, cessation counselling intervenes before health damage becomes evident and reduces the chance of later disease, which is generally placed at the secondary level. The purpose of this question is to break the intuition that one measure corresponds to one level — real public health programmes usually operate on several levels at once. Identify the target group first, then assign a level to each, rather than forcing a single label onto the whole programme.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

optionsEn: a municipal service rather than prevention
hm_floor_08.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
改善舊區的排水與垃圾收集系統，以減少蚊患及傳染病傳播，屬於哪一級預防？
hm_floor_08.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Improving drainage and refuse collection in an old district to reduce mosquitoes and the spread of infectious disease is which level of prevention?
hm_floor_08.explanation:
改善環境是在疾病發生之前移除傳播的條件，令居民根本不會受感染，屬一級預防。這一條同時示範了一個重要觀念：預防未必以個人為單位。健康教育針對個人行為，環境改善針對整個社區所共處的條件，兩者同屬一級預防，但後者不需要每個居民各自作出改變便能生效，覆蓋面往往更廣。答論述題談公共衞生成效時，指出環境層面的介入不依賴個人自律這一點，是相當有力的分析。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_08.explanationEn:
Improving the environment removes the conditions for transmission before disease occurs, so that residents do not become infected at all, making it primary prevention. This question also illustrates an important idea: prevention need not operate on individuals. Health education addresses personal behaviour, while environmental improvement addresses conditions the whole community shares; both are primary prevention, but the latter takes effect without requiring each resident to change anything and so usually reaches further. Noting that environmental intervention does not depend on individual self-discipline is a strong analytical point when discussing public health effectiveness in an essay.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 對甲屬二級，對乙屬三級
對甲屬一級，對乙屬二級
對甲屬一級，對乙屬一級

primary for A, secondary for B
secondary for both A and B
primary for A and primary for B
hm_floor_09.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
「定期量度血壓」這項行為，對甲（血壓正常的成年人）與乙（已確診高血壓並服藥的病人）而言，分別屬於哪一級預防？
hm_floor_09.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Regular blood pressure measurement: for A, an adult with normal blood pressure, and for B, a patient already diagnosed with hypertension and on medication, which levels of prevention apply?
hm_floor_09.explanation:
同一項措施的級別取決於服務對象所處的階段，而非措施本身。對甲而言，他尚未確診，量血壓的作用是在高血壓引起症狀之前把它找出來，屬二級預防。對乙而言，他已確診並在治療之中，量血壓的作用是監察病情、調校藥物、減少中風與腎衰竭等併發症，屬三級預防。要留意甲的情況並非一級——一級預防要降低患高血壓的風險本身，例如減鹽、運動、控制體重；量度這個動作並不改變風險，只改變發現的時機。本題正是要檢驗這個分類原則有沒有真正掌握，而不是背例子。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_09.explanationEn:
The level of any measure depends on the stage the person is at, not on the measure itself. For A, who is not yet diagnosed, taking blood pressure serves to find hypertension before it produces symptoms, which is secondary prevention. For B, who is diagnosed and under treatment, it serves to monitor the condition, adjust medication and reduce complications such as stroke and kidney failure, which is tertiary prevention. Note that A's case is not primary: primary prevention would lower the risk of developing hypertension in the first place, through less salt, exercise and weight control; measuring does not change the risk, only when it is found. The question tests whether the classifying principle is genuinely understood rather than the examples memorised.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hm_floor_11.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名中六學生因為模擬試成績不理想而持續失眠、情緒低落。就整全健康而言，這主要屬於哪一個方面？
hm_floor_11.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A Secondary 6 student has persistent insomnia and low mood after a disappointing mock examination. In holistic health terms, which dimension is chiefly affected?
hm_floor_11.explanation:
情緒低落與因壓力而起的失眠，主要反映心理健康的狀況。要補充的是，整全健康的三個方面互相影響而非各自獨立：長期失眠會削弱免疫力與專注力，屬身體層面的後果；情緒低落亦可能令人退出社交活動，屬社交層面的後果。答應用題時應先指出主要受影響的方面，再說明它如何牽動其餘兩方面——這種「主次分明兼顧關聯」的寫法，比單獨指出一個方面更能拿到分析分。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_11.explanationEn:
Low mood and stress-related insomnia chiefly reflect the state of mental health. It should be added that the three dimensions interact rather than standing apart: prolonged insomnia weakens immunity and concentration, which is a physical consequence, while low mood may lead someone to withdraw from social activity, which is a social one. In an application question, identify the dimension chiefly affected first, then explain how it draws in the other two — this way of writing, clear about what is primary while still showing the connections, earns more analysis marks than naming a single dimension alone.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

optionsEn: it benefits only the elderly visited
it does not affect their own health
hm_floor_12.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名退休人士加入義工隊，每週與街坊一同探訪獨居長者。這主要促進了他健康的哪一方面？
hm_floor_12.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A retiree joins a volunteer team and visits elderly people living alone with neighbours each week. Which dimension of their own health does this chiefly promote?
hm_floor_12.explanation:
社交健康指一個人與他人建立及維持關係、在群體中擔當角色的能力。參與義工隊令這名退休人士有穩定的人際接觸、有被需要的角色，正是社交健康的核心內容。退休往往同時帶來社會角色的失去，因此這類參與對長者的健康特別重要。要留意這項活動並非只令受訪者得益——這正是本題要指出的一點；同時探訪需要外出步行，亦附帶身體層面的好處，但那是次要的。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_12.explanationEn:
Social health refers to a person's capacity to form and maintain relationships and to hold a role within a group. Joining a volunteer team gives this retiree steady human contact and a role in which they are needed, which is the core of social health. Retirement often brings the loss of a social role, so participation of this kind matters particularly for older people's health. Note that the activity does not benefit only those visited — that is the point the question is making; the walking involved brings incidental physical benefit as well, but that is secondary.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 前者視健康為多維度的積極狀態
前者主張毋須依賴任何醫療服務
兩者在本質上並無實際分別
前者只重視心理而不理會身體
optionsEn: the former treats health as a positive, multidimensional state
the former holds that medical services are unnecessary
the two are not meaningfully different
the former attends to the mind and ignores the body
hm_floor_13.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
整全健康觀與傳統醫學模式的主要分別在於甚麼？
hm_floor_13.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What is the main difference between a holistic view of health and the traditional medical model?
hm_floor_13.explanation:
傳統醫學模式以疾病為中心，健康即是沒有病，介入的重點是診斷與治療。整全健康觀則把健康看成身體、心理與社交三方面的積極狀態，關注的不只是病人，也包括未病者的生活條件、心理狀況與社會連繫。要留意整全觀並不否定醫療的價值——它是把醫療放進一個更闊的框架之中，而非取代它。同樣，它亦不是重心理而輕身體，三個方面在整全觀之中地位相當。分辨這兩個模式時，問一句「這個框架關心的是疾病，還是人的整體狀態」，最能抓住重點。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_13.explanationEn:
The traditional medical model is disease-centred: health means the absence of illness, and the focus of intervention is diagnosis and treatment. A holistic view treats health as a positive state across the physical, mental and social dimensions, and attends not only to patients but also to the living conditions, psychological state and social connections of those who are not ill. Note that the holistic view does not deny the value of medicine — it places medicine within a broader frame rather than replacing it. Nor does it favour the mind over the body; the three dimensions carry equal weight within it. Asking whether a framework is concerned with disease or with the whole state of a person is the quickest way to tell the two apart.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 身體方面受限，心理與社交方面良好
慢性病人不適用整全健康的框架
因患有慢性病，故三方面皆不健康
因情緒與社交良好，故完全健康
optionsEn: limited physically, but sound mentally and socially
the holistic framework does not apply to chronic illness
unhealthy in all three dimensions because of the illness
completely healthy, since mood and social life are good
hm_floor_14.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名長者患有需長期服藥的慢性病，但情緒穩定、朋友眾多、每日仍能自理起居。就整全健康而言，對他最恰當的判斷是甚麼？
hm_floor_14.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
An older person has a chronic illness requiring long-term medication, yet is emotionally stable, has many friends and manages daily living unaided. What is the most appropriate holistic judgement?
hm_floor_14.explanation:
整全健康的三個方面應分開評估，不應以其中一項概括全部。這名長者身體方面確有限制，但心理與社交狀況良好，整體上仍可過有質素的生活。這正是整全健康觀最實用的地方：慢性病無法治癒，若以「有病即不健康」來衡量，病人便永遠處於失敗的位置；而按三維度分別評估，照顧的目標便可以放在維持與提升仍然良好的方面。答論述題時，指出「健康是連續體而非有病無病的二分」，是這個課題的核心分析點。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_14.explanationEn:
The three dimensions should be assessed separately rather than letting one stand for all. This person is indeed limited physically, but their mental and social condition is sound and they can still live well overall. This is where the holistic view is most useful in practice: a chronic illness cannot be cured, and judging by whether illness is present leaves the patient permanently in a position of failure, whereas assessing each dimension separately allows care to aim at maintaining and strengthening what remains sound. Stating in an essay that health is a continuum rather than a division into ill and not ill is the central analytical point of this topic.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 健康程度可以逐步移動而非二分
健康狀況一旦下降便無法回升
健康只有健康與患病兩種狀態
健康程度完全由遺傳因素決定
optionsEn: health can shift by degrees rather than being binary
once health declines it cannot be regained
there are only two states: healthy and ill
the level of health is determined entirely by genes
hm_floor_15.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
「健康是一個連續體」這個說法，最主要的意思是甚麼？
hm_floor_15.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What does the statement that health is a continuum chiefly mean?
hm_floor_15.explanation:
把健康理解為連續體，意思是每個人在任何時刻都處於「極差」與「極佳」之間的某一點，並且這個位置會隨生活條件、照顧與自身努力而移動。這個觀念有兩個實際作用：其一，即使患病亦有改善的空間，照顧因此有意義；其二，即使未患病亦有提升的空間，健康促進因此有意義。若把健康看成有病與無病的二分，這兩件事都會失去理據。連續體的方向可以雙向移動，並非只降不升；而遺傳只是影響健康的因素之一，環境與生活方式同樣重要。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_15.explanationEn:
Treating health as a continuum means that at any moment each person sits somewhere between very poor and very good, and that this position moves with living conditions, care and personal effort. The idea does two practical jobs: first, there is room for improvement even in illness, which is what makes care meaningful; second, there is room for improvement even without illness, which is what makes health promotion meaningful. Both lose their rationale if health is seen as a division into ill and not ill. Movement along the continuum runs in both directions, not downward only, and heredity is one influence among several, with environment and lifestyle mattering just as much.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 兼顧身體、心理與社交的整全照顧
集中處理長者的經濟困難
把照顧責任全數交回家人承擔
以治療疾病為唯一目標的醫療模式
optionsEn: holistic care spanning physical, mental and social needs
a focus on the financial difficulties of the elderly
returning all responsibility for care to the family
a medical model aimed solely at treating disease
hm_floor_16.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
社區中心為獨居長者同時安排定期覆診接送、興趣班及家居安全評估。這套服務最能體現甚麼？
hm_floor_16.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A community centre arranges transport to medical appointments, interest classes, and home safety assessments for elderly people living alone. What does this best illustrate?
hm_floor_16.explanation:
三項服務各自對應不同的方面：覆診接送保障治療的延續，屬身體層面；興趣班提供人際接觸與生活內容，兼及心理與社交；家居安全評估減低跌倒風險，同時屬身體層面與環境層面的介入。三者合起來，正是整全照顧的具體做法——不只處理疾病，而是照顧一個人生活的整體。答應用題時逐項對應到相應的方面，比籠統地寫「服務全面」清楚得多，亦更容易取分。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_16.explanationEn:
Each service addresses a different dimension: transport to appointments secures continuity of treatment and is physical; interest classes supply human contact and content to daily life, touching both the mental and social dimensions; home safety assessment lowers the risk of falls and is both a physical and an environmental intervention. Taken together they are holistic care in concrete form — not merely treating disease but attending to a person's life as a whole. Mapping each service to its dimension is far clearer than writing in general terms that the service is comprehensive, and it scores better.

兩者的服務對象完全相同
前者只適用於已確診的病人

hm_floor_17.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
「健康促進」與「疾病治療」的主要分別在於甚麼？
hm_floor_17.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What chiefly distinguishes health promotion from the treatment of disease?
hm_floor_17.explanation:
健康促進的目標是令人由「不算差」移向「更好」，對象包括未患病的人，手段涵蓋教育、環境改善與政策；疾病治療則針對已出現的病症，目標是消除或控制它。兩者的對象與時機都不同，但並非互相排斥——一個完整的健康系統兩者兼備。健康促進的推行亦不限於醫生，學校、社區組織、僱主以至政策制訂者都有角色，這一點在論述題中值得指出，因為它反映健康並非單靠醫療服務就能達致。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_17.explanationEn:
Health promotion aims to move people from not bad towards better, addresses those who are not ill as well as those who are, and works through education, environmental improvement and policy. Treatment addresses symptoms that have already appeared and aims to remove or control them. The two differ in whom they serve and when they act, but they are not mutually exclusive — a complete health system contains both. Health promotion is also not carried out by doctors alone: schools, community organisations, employers and policymakers all have a part, a point worth making in an essay because it shows that health is not achieved through medical services alone.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 尊重服務使用者為自己作決定的權利
照顧者可按專業判斷代為決定
服務使用者須自行承擔照顧責任
家屬的意願優先於使用者本人
optionsEn: respecting the user's right to decide for themselves
allowing carers to decide on professional grounds
making users responsible for their own care
giving the family's wishes priority over the user's
hm_floor_18.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
照顧倫理中的「尊重自主」原則，主要指甚麼？
hm_floor_18.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What does the principle of respect for autonomy in care ethics chiefly mean?
hm_floor_18.explanation:
尊重自主指服務使用者有權在充分知情的前提下，就自己的身體與照顧安排作決定，包括拒絕某項治療的權利。要留意「自主」並不等於「自己照顧自己」——一個需要別人協助起居的人，同樣可以自主地決定接受哪些協助。這個原則的落實依賴知情同意：先提供足夠而可理解的資訊，再由本人決定。當本人的決定與家屬意願或照顧者的專業判斷相左時，正是這個原則發揮作用的時刻；若一律以專業或家屬意見為準，原則便形同虛設。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_18.explanationEn:
Respect for autonomy means that a service user has the right, once adequately informed, to make decisions about their own body and care arrangements, including the right to refuse a treatment. Note that autonomy is not the same as looking after oneself — someone who needs help with daily living can still decide autonomously which help to accept. The principle is realised through informed consent: sufficient and comprehensible information first, then the person's own decision. It matters most precisely when that decision conflicts with the family's wishes or the carer's professional judgement; if professional or family views always prevail, the principle is empty.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 居住環境的擠迫與衞生狀況
個人的血型與遺傳基因
身體對藥物的代謝速度
optionsEn: a person's blood type and genes
the rate at which the body metabolises drugs
the inborn strength of the immune system
hm_floor_19.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
下列哪一項屬於「健康的社會決定因素」？
hm_floor_19.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Which of the following is a social determinant of health?
hm_floor_19.explanation:
健康的社會決定因素，指影響健康而本身屬社會條件的因素，例如收入、教育程度、就業狀況、居住環境與能否獲得醫療服務。居住環境的擠迫與衞生直接影響傳染病傳播與精神壓力，屬典型的社會決定因素。其餘三項均屬生物或生理層面的因素，雖然同樣影響健康，但並非社會條件。分辨的方法很直接：問一句「這項因素可否透過政策或社會資源分配去改變」——可以的，多屬社會決定因素。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_19.explanationEn:
The social determinants of health are the social conditions that influence health, such as income, education, employment, housing and access to medical services. Overcrowding and poor sanitation in housing bear directly on the spread of infection and on mental strain, making them a textbook social determinant. The other three are biological or physiological factors: they affect health too, but they are not social conditions. A direct test is to ask whether the factor could be changed by policy or by the allocation of social resources — if so, it is usually a social determinant.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

options: 避免對服務使用者造成可預見的傷害
照顧者須為所有意外結果承擔法律責任
只要出於好意便毋須考慮後果
在任何情況下都不可施行入侵性程序
optionsEn: avoiding foreseeable harm to the service user
holding carers legally liable for every mishap
good intentions removing the need to weigh outcomes
never carrying out any invasive procedure
hm_floor_20.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
照顧倫理中的「不傷害」原則，其基本要求是甚麼？
hm_floor_20.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What is the basic requirement of the principle of non-maleficence in care ethics?
hm_floor_20.explanation:
不傷害原則要求照顧者避免造成可預見的傷害，並在無法完全避免時把傷害減至最低。它並非禁止一切具風險的程序——手術、注射本身有風險，但若預期利益明顯大於風險，仍然可以進行，這正是它與行善原則需要一併衡量的原因。要留意「出於好意」不足以構成理據：判斷的依據是後果的預期，而非動機的善惡。這個分別在討論強制餵食、約束衣等具爭議的照顧措施時尤其關鍵。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_20.explanationEn:
Non-maleficence requires carers to avoid foreseeable harm and, where harm cannot be entirely avoided, to keep it to a minimum. It does not forbid every risky procedure — surgery and injections carry risk, yet may proceed where the expected benefit clearly outweighs it, which is why this principle must be weighed together with beneficence. Note that good intentions are not sufficient grounds: the judgement rests on expected outcomes rather than on the goodness of the motive. This distinction is especially important when discussing contested measures such as force-feeding or physical restraint.

options: 長者本人在知情下所作的決定
醫生的專業判斷應為最終標準
以少數服從多數的方式決定
家人所表達的一致意願
optionsEn: the person's own decision, made with full information
the doctor's professional judgement as final
deciding by majority among those involved
the unanimous wishes expressed by the family
hm_floor_21.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名意識清醒的長者拒絕接受醫生建議的手術，家人則堅持要做。就照顧倫理而言，處理這情況時應以甚麼為首要考慮？
hm_floor_21.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A mentally competent older person refuses an operation their doctor recommends, while the family insists on it. In care ethics, what should be the primary consideration?
hm_floor_21.explanation:
長者意識清醒，具備作決定的能力，尊重自主原則要求以他本人在知情下的決定為首要考慮，包括拒絕治療的決定。這並不表示家人與醫生的意見沒有價值——醫生有責任充分說明手術的利弊與不做的後果，家人的關心亦應獲聆聽，但兩者的角色是提供資訊與支援，而非代為決定。要留意這個原則的前提是當事人有決定能力；若能力受損，處理方式便不同，須依循預設醫療指示或代作決定的機制。答題時先確認決定能力，再談原則，次序不能倒轉。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_21.explanationEn:
The person is mentally competent and has the capacity to decide, so respect for autonomy requires that their own informed decision, including a refusal of treatment, be the primary consideration. This does not make the views of family and doctor worthless — the doctor has a duty to explain fully the benefits and risks of the operation and the consequences of declining it, and the family's concern deserves a hearing, but their role is to inform and support rather than to decide. Note that the principle presupposes decision-making capacity; where capacity is impaired the approach differs and advance directives or substitute decision-making mechanisms apply. Establish capacity first and then discuss the principle — the order cannot be reversed.

options: 經濟條件影響飲食選擇與牙科服務的可及性
兩類家庭兒童的體質存在先天差異
數字差異只是統計上的偶然波動
基層家庭的家長普遍不重視子女健康
optionsEn: income shapes diet choices and access to dental services
the two groups differ in inborn physical constitution
the gap is merely random statistical fluctuation
low-income parents generally neglect their children's health
hm_floor_22.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
研究顯示，基層家庭兒童的蛀牙率明顯高於中產家庭。從健康決定因素的角度，最恰當的解釋是甚麼？
hm_floor_22.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Studies show that children in low-income families have markedly higher rates of tooth decay than those in middle-class families. From a determinants-of-health perspective, what is the most appropriate explanation?
hm_floor_22.explanation:
社會決定因素的分析要求先看結構性條件，再談個人行為。經濟條件透過幾條途徑影響蛀牙率：能否負擔定期牙科檢查與治療、能否選購較昂貴而含糖較少的食物、家長工時長短是否容許督促子女刷牙。把差異歸咎於家長不重視，是典型的「責備受害者」，它把結構問題誤讀為態度問題，亦令有效的政策介入無從談起。體質差異的說法缺乏證據支持；而群體之間持續而一致的差距，亦不能用偶然波動解釋。答論述題時能指出「責備受害者」這個陷阱，是本課題的關鍵分析點。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_22.explanationEn:
Analysis of social determinants requires looking at structural conditions before individual behaviour. Income affects rates of decay through several routes: whether regular dental check-ups and treatment are affordable, whether costlier low-sugar foods can be bought, and whether parents' working hours leave time to supervise toothbrushing. Attributing the gap to parental neglect is a textbook case of blaming the victim: it reads a structural problem as a matter of attitude and leaves no room for effective policy. The suggestion of differing constitutions lacks evidence, and a persistent, consistent gap between groups cannot be explained as random fluctuation. Identifying the victim-blaming trap is the key analytical point in this topic.

options: 資訊充分、當事人有能力、自願作出決定
只需當事人在同意書上簽署作實
只需家屬代為表示同意即可
只需醫護人員認為方案對當事人有利
optionsEn: adequate information, capacity, and a voluntary decision
a signature on a consent form is enough
consent given on the person's behalf by relatives
the staff judging the plan to be in the person's interest
hm_floor_23.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
「知情同意」要有效，必須具備哪些條件？
hm_floor_23.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What conditions must be met for informed consent to be valid?
hm_floor_23.explanation:
知情同意有三個必要條件，缺一不可。其一是資訊充分且可理解——包括方案的性質、預期效果、風險與可行的替代方案。其二是當事人具備決定能力，即能理解資訊並衡量後果。其三是自願，即決定不受壓力或誤導所左右。簽署同意書只是把同意記錄下來的形式，若當事人根本不明白內容，這份文件並不構成有效的同意。家屬代為同意僅在當事人欠缺決定能力時、按既定機制才適用；而照顧者認為有利，屬行善原則的考慮，不能取代當事人的意願。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_23.explanationEn:
Informed consent has three necessary conditions, none of which can be omitted. The first is adequate and comprehensible information, covering the nature of the proposal, the expected benefit, the risks and the available alternatives. The second is capacity: the person can understand the information and weigh the consequences. The third is voluntariness: the decision is free of pressure or misleading influence. Signing a form merely records consent; where the person does not understand what it says, the document does not constitute valid consent. Consent by relatives applies only where the person lacks capacity, through established mechanisms; and a carer's belief that something is beneficial belongs to beneficence and cannot replace the person's own wishes.

options: 按需要公平分配，不因身分而有差別
一律平均分配予每一名服務使用者
優先照顧付款能力較高的使用者
由前線照顧者按個人喜好決定
optionsEn: fair allocation by need, without regard to status
an exactly equal share for every service user
priority for those able to pay more
frontline carers deciding by personal preference
hm_floor_24.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
照顧倫理中的「公義」原則，在資源分配上主要要求甚麼？
hm_floor_24.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In the allocation of resources, what does the principle of justice in care ethics chiefly require?
hm_floor_24.explanation:
公義原則要求資源分配以需要為依據，並且不因性別、年齡、種族、經濟狀況或社會地位而有差別待遇。要留意「公平」與「平均」並不相同：需要程度不一的人若各得相同份額，結果反而不公平——需要多的人不足，需要少的人有餘。因此公義原則在實踐上常指向「按需分配」而非「人人一份」。以付款能力決定優次，違反不因經濟狀況差別待遇這一要求；而由前線照顧者按個人喜好決定，則缺乏可交代的準則，同樣不符合公義原則。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_24.explanationEn:
The principle of justice requires that resources be allocated according to need, without differential treatment on grounds of sex, age, race, economic position or social status. Note that fair and equal are not the same: giving people with unequal needs identical shares produces an unfair result, leaving those with greater need short and those with less need with a surplus. In practice, therefore, justice points towards allocation by need rather than an equal share for all. Setting priority by ability to pay breaches the requirement not to discriminate on economic grounds, while leaving the decision to a frontline carer's personal preference provides no accountable criterion and fails the principle equally.

options: 僅屬行政程序上的疏忽
optionsEn: merely a lapse in administrative procedure
hm_floor_25.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名照顧者為方便管理，在未經評估的情況下為長者長期使用約束衣。這做法主要違反了哪些倫理原則？
hm_floor_25.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
For ease of management, a carer keeps an older person in physical restraints long-term without any assessment. Which ethical principles does this chiefly breach?
hm_floor_25.explanation:
長期約束在未經評估與同意之下施行，剝奪了長者對自己身體與行動的決定權，違反尊重自主；長期約束亦會帶來肌肉萎縮、關節僵硬、褥瘡與情緒困擾等可預見的傷害，違反不傷害。要留意「為方便管理」這個理由本身正是問題所在——它以照顧者的便利取代了使用者的利益，而倫理判斷的依據應是後者。保密涉及私隱資料的處理，公義涉及資源分配，兩者與本個案的核心無關。把這件事僅僅當作程序疏忽，會低估它對當事人造成的實質損害。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hm_floor_25.explanationEn:
Applying long-term restraint without assessment or consent removes the person's authority over their own body and movement, breaching respect for autonomy; prolonged restraint also brings foreseeable harm such as muscle wasting, joint stiffness, pressure sores and emotional distress, breaching non-maleficence. Note that the stated reason, ease of management, is itself the problem — it substitutes the carer's convenience for the user's interests, when ethical judgement should rest on the latter. Confidentiality concerns the handling of private information and justice concerns the allocation of resources; neither bears on the core of this case. Treating the matter as a mere procedural lapse understates the real harm done to the person concerned.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb_hm1_50_24.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
某地區人口 50,000 人，一年內錄得 24 宗某疾病的新症。該病的發病率是每十萬人多少宗？
hmb_hm1_50_24.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A district of 50,000 people records 24 new cases of a disease in one year. What is the incidence rate per 100,000 population?
hmb_hm1_50_24.explanation:
發病率 = 新症數目 ÷ 人口 × 100,000 = 24 ÷ 50,000 × 100,000 = 48 宗／十萬人。要用【率】而非絕對數字作比較，因為人口規模不同的地區，個案數目本身不可比 —— 大城市個案較多，未必代表風險較高。另須分清【發病率】（一段期間內的新症）與【患病率】（某一時點的所有現存病例，包括舊症）。陷阱：24 只抄了個案數目；0.048 乘了 100 而非 100,000；2083.3 把分子分母倒轉。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb_hm1_50_24.explanationEn:
Incidence = new cases ÷ population × 100,000 = 24 ÷ 50,000 × 100,000 = 48 per 100,000. Rates rather than raw counts must be used for comparison, since districts of different size are not comparable on counts alone — a large city has more cases without necessarily carrying higher risk. Distinguish also INCIDENCE, the new cases over a period, from PREVALENCE, all existing cases at a point in time. Traps: 24 copies the case count; 0.048 multiplies by 100 rather than 100,000; 2083.3 inverts the fraction.

某社區的目標接種人數為 2,000 人，實際完成接種 900 人。接種覆蓋率是多少？
hmb_hm2_2000_45.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A community targets 2,000 people for vaccination and 900 are vaccinated. What is the coverage rate?
hmb_hm2_2000_45.explanation:
覆蓋率 = 已接種人數 ÷ 目標人數 × 100% = 900 ÷ 2,000 × 100% = 45%。覆蓋率之所以重要，是因為【群體免疫】需要足夠比例的人接種才能形成：當易感者比例低到病原難以持續傳播，未能接種的人（如免疫力弱者、太年幼者）也會間接受保護。所需的覆蓋率視乎該病的傳染力而定，麻疹等高傳染力疾病要求尤其高。陷阱：222.2% 把分子分母倒轉，得出大於 100% 的結果；55% 算的是未接種比例；900% 把人數當成百分率。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb_hm2_2000_45.explanationEn:
Coverage = number vaccinated ÷ target population × 100% = 900 ÷ 2,000 × 100% = 45%. Coverage matters because HERD IMMUNITY requires a sufficient proportion to be vaccinated: once susceptible people are scarce enough that the pathogen cannot sustain transmission, those who cannot be vaccinated — the immunocompromised, the very young — are indirectly protected. The threshold depends on how transmissible the disease is, and highly infectious diseases such as measles demand especially high coverage. Traps: 222.2% inverts the fraction and exceeds 100%; 55% is the unvaccinated share; 900% reads a headcount as a percentage.

hmb_pv1_vaccinating _a.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Which level of prevention is vaccinating junior secondary students?
hmb_pv1_vaccinating _a.explanation:
「為初中學生接種疫苗」屬第一級預防，因為它在疾病發生【之前】降低發病風險。三級預防的分界不在於措施本身有多積極，而在於【介入時點相對疾病進程的位置】：病前為第一級，早期無症狀為第二級，病後減害為第三級。同一種行為在不同時點可以落入不同層級——為健康人士做的運動指導屬第一級，為心臟病康復者做的則屬第三級。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb_pv1_vaccinating _a.explanationEn:
Vaccinating junior secondary students is primary prevention, because it involves reducing risk BEFORE disease occurs. The boundaries do not depend on how vigorous a measure is but on WHERE THE INTERVENTION SITS RELATIVE TO THE DISEASE PROCESS: before onset is primary, early and asymptomatic is secondary, and after onset is tertiary. The same activity can fall into different levels at different points — exercise advice for a healthy person is primary, while the same advice for someone recovering from heart disease is tertiary.

hmb_pv1_giving foot-_a.explanationEn:

hmb_ho1_physical h_d.content:

hmb_ho1_physical h_d.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In the holistic concept of health, what does physical health refer to?
hmb_ho1_physical h_d.explanation:
「身體健康」指身體機能與生理狀態，例如體適能、睡眠與營養。整全健康的核心主張是各個面向【互相影響】而非各自獨立：長期缺乏社交支援會影響情緒，情緒困擾又會影響睡眠與免疫功能。因此評估健康不能只看單一指標，而干預亦不應只針對表面症狀。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb_ho1_physical h_d.explanationEn:
Physical health refers to bodily function and physiology, such as fitness, sleep and nutrition. The central claim of holistic health is that the dimensions INTERACT rather than stand apart: prolonged lack of social support affects mood, and distress in turn affects sleep and immune function. Health therefore cannot be assessed on a single indicator, and intervention should not address only the surface symptom.

「職業健康」指工作與生活的平衡，以及工作帶來的滿足與壓力。整全健康的核心主張是各個面向【互相影響】而非各自獨立：長期缺乏社交支援會影響情緒，情緒困擾又會影響睡眠與免疫功能。因此評估健康不能只看單一指標，而干預亦不應只針對表面症狀。

hmb_ho1_occupation_d.explanationEn:
Occupational health refers to the balance between work and life, and the satisfaction and strain that work brings. The central claim of holistic health is that the dimensions INTERACT rather than stand apart: prolonged lack of social support affects mood, and distress in turn affects sleep and immune function. hmb_hp1_2000_40.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
某社區有 2000 名居民，一年內有 40 人新確診某疾病。每千人的發病率是多少？
hmb_hp1_2000_40.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In a community of 2000 residents, 40 people are newly diagnosed with a disease in one year. What is the incidence per 1000?
hmb_hp1_2000_40.explanation:
發病率 = $\dfrac{40}{2000} \times 1000 = 20$／千人。要分清【發病率】與【盛行率】：發病率只計某段時間內的【新】個案，反映疾病發生的速度；盛行率則計某一時點的【所有】個案（新舊皆計），反映負擔的總量。慢性病的盛行率可以很高而發病率不高，因為患者長期存活而不斷累積。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb_hp1_2000_40.explanationEn:
Incidence = $\dfrac{40}{2000} \times 1000 = 20$ per 1000. Distinguish INCIDENCE from PREVALENCE: incidence counts only NEW cases arising in a period and reflects the rate at which disease occurs, while prevalence counts ALL cases present at a point in time, new and old alike, and reflects total burden. A chronic disease can have high prevalence but low incidence, because those affected survive and accumulate.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb_cs1_primary ca.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What role does primary care play in the health care system?
hmb_cs1_primary ca.explanation:
基層醫療首個接觸點，處理常見疾病、預防與轉介。分層的用意在於【把資源與需要配對】：若所有問題都直接湧向第三層，成本高昂而輪候時間拉長，真正需要高度專科的病人反而被延誤。強化基層醫療之所以是政策重點，正因為它能在問題變複雜之前處理，並承擔預防與長期跟進的角色。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb_cs1_primary ca.explanationEn:
Primary care is the first point of contact, handling common conditions, prevention and referral. The point of tiering is to MATCH RESOURCES TO NEED: if every problem went straight to the tertiary level, costs would rise and waiting times lengthen, delaying the patients who genuinely require highly specialised care. Strengthening primary care is a policy priority precisely because it addresses problems before they grow complex, and carries prevention and long-term follow-up.

hmb_ce1_respect for _d.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In care ethics, what does respect for autonomy mean?
hmb_ce1_respect for _d.explanation:
「自主原則」指尊重服務使用者自行作出知情決定的權利。四項原則在實務中經常互相衝突：例如一名認知能力尚存的長者拒絕接受治療，自主原則要求尊重其決定，行善原則卻指向介入。倫理判斷的工作不是背誦原則，而是在具體處境中衡量各原則的分量，並說明取捨的理由。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb_ce1_respect for _d.explanationEn:
Respect for autonomy means respecting the right to make informed decisions for oneself. The four principles frequently conflict in practice: when an older person with intact capacity refuses treatment, autonomy requires that the decision be respected while beneficence points towards intervening. Ethical reasoning is not the recitation of principles but the weighing of their force in a particular situation, together with reasons for the choice made.

hmb_dt1_income and s.explanation:
「收入與社會地位」主要影響能否負擔健康的食物、居所與求醫。健康決定因素的核心觀點是：健康差距很大程度由【個人選擇以外的條件】造成，故單靠健康教育難以拉近差距——若一個家庭負擔不起新鮮蔬果，再多的營養資訊亦改變不了餐桌。這正是政策層面的介入（房屋、收入保障、社區設施）被視為健康措施的原因。

hmb_dt1_income and s.explanationEn:
Income and social position acts mainly by shaping whether healthy food, housing and care are affordable. The central insight of the determinants framework is that health inequalities arise largely from CONDITIONS BEYOND INDIVIDUAL CHOICE, so health education alone cannot close them: no amount of nutritional information changes what is on the table if a household cannot afford fresh produce. This is why interventions in housing, income security and community facilities are regarded as health measures.

hmb_sk1_assisting an.explanation:
要點是：事前說明步驟並取得同意，動作分段而不突然。所有照顧技巧背後有一條共通原則——【保留對方的能力與尊嚴】。照顧者代勞得愈多，服務使用者的能力流失得愈快，這稱為過度照顧。恰當的做法是提供剛好足夠的協助，讓對方仍然參與，而非把事情全部做完。

hmb_sk1_assisting an.explanationEn:
The key point is explaining the steps and obtaining consent first, then moving in stages rather than abruptly. One principle underlies every care skill: PRESERVE THE PERSON'S CAPACITY AND DIGNITY. The more a carer does on someone's behalf, the faster that person's own ability declines — this is over-caring. The right approach is to give just enough assistance for the person to remain involved, rather than completing the task for them.

Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
If a health policy were framed entirely through the biomedical model, what blind spot would most likely arise?
hmb_hc2_biomedical.explanation:
任何模式都是【一種看法】，看見某些東西的同時必然遮蔽另一些。生物醫學模式把健康視為沒有疾病，焦點在病理與治療，其盲點正在於它不處理的層面。實務上的做法並非挑選唯一正確的模式，而是自覺地指出「我此刻用哪一個視角、它看不見甚麼」，再以其他視角補足。

hmb_hc2_biomedical.explanationEn:
Every model is A WAY OF SEEING, and in showing some things it necessarily obscures others. The biomedical model treats health as treating health as the absence of disease, focusing on pathology and cure, and its blind spot lies precisely in what it does not address. The practical response is not to choose one correct model but to state deliberately which perspective is in use and what it cannot see, then supplement it with the others.

hmb_ce2_respect for.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名認知能力健全的服務使用者，其決定與照顧者認為對他最有利的做法相反。就「自主原則」而言，這個處境如何理解？
hmb_ce2_respect for.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A service user with full capacity makes a decision contrary to what the carer believes is best for them. How does respect for autonomy bear on this situation?
hmb_ce2_respect for.explanation:
「自主原則」要求尊重服務使用者自行作出知情決定的權利。此處境正是自主與行善相衝突的典型：使用者有能力作決定，其選擇卻可能帶來風險。倫理上的正確處理不是宣布某一原則勝出，而是先確認能力是否健全、資訊是否充分，再在衡量之後說明取捨的理由，並把決定過程記錄下來。單方面代為決定，在使用者具備能力時並不正當。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb_ce2_respect for.explanationEn:
Respect for autonomy requires respecting the right to make informed decisions for oneself. This situation is the classic conflict between autonomy and beneficence: the user has capacity, yet their choice may carry risk. The ethically sound response is not to declare one principle the winner but to establish first whether capacity is intact and information adequate, then to weigh, state the reasons for the choice made, and record the process. Deciding unilaterally is not legitimate where the user has capacity.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

某地最富裕地區的預期壽命為 80 歲，最貧窮地區為 68 歲。兩者相差多少歲？
hmb2_dt1_80_68.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Life expectancy is 80 years in a territory's wealthiest district and 68 in its poorest. What is the gap, in years?
hmb2_dt1_80_68.explanation:
差距 = $80 - 68 = 12$ 歲。這 12 年【不是】由個人選擇造成：住屋、收入、教育、工作環境與就醫距離共同構成健康的社會決定因素。把差距歸咎於「窮人生活習慣差」，會令政策方向由改善條件變成勸告個人，而後者對這 12 年幾乎無效。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_dt1_80_68.explanationEn:
The gap is $80 - 68 = 12$ years. Those 12 years are NOT a matter of individual choice: housing, income, education, working conditions and distance to care together form the social determinants of health. Attributing the gap to "poor lifestyle choices" shifts policy from improving conditions to advising individuals, and the latter barely moves those 12 years.

hmb2_sy1_1000_300.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
某地區有 1000 張公立醫院病床，人口 300 千人。每千人可分得多少張病床？
hmb2_sy1_1000_300.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A district has 1000 public hospital beds for a population of 300 thousand. How many beds are there per thousand people?
hmb2_sy1_1000_300.explanation:
每千人病床數 = $1000 \div 300 = 3.33$ 張。⚠️ 這個比率【不能單獨判斷醫療是否足夠】：一個以社區與家居照顧為主的體系，病床比率會較低而服務未必較差；反之病床多而人手不足，床位一樣用不上。要一併看的是醫護人手比、平均住院日數與輪候時間。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_sy1_1000_300.explanationEn:
Beds per thousand = $1000 \div 300 = 3.33$. NOTE this ratio ALONE cannot say whether provision is adequate: a system built on community and home care shows fewer beds without worse service, while abundant beds with too few staff cannot be used. Staffing ratios, average length of stay and waiting times must be read alongside.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb2_cm1_2_3_4.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名長者接受家居照顧服務，每次 2 小時、每週 3 次，持續 4 週。合共接受多少小時服務？
hmb2_cm1_2_3_4.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
An older person receives home care of 2 hours per visit, 3 times a week, for 4 weeks. How many hours of service is that in total?
hmb2_cm1_2_3_4.explanation:
總時數 = $2 \times 3 \times 4 = 24$ 小時。社區照顧的政策取向是【原址安老】：讓長者留在熟悉的環境，維持既有的社交網絡與生活節奏。院舍雖然照顧密度高，但代價是離開自己的生活場景，而這一項無法用服務時數補回。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_cm1_2_3_4.explanationEn:
Total = $2 \times 3 \times 4 = 24$ hours. The policy direction in community care is AGEING IN PLACE: keeping people in familiar surroundings so their social network and daily rhythm survive. Residential care offers denser support but at the cost of leaving one's own setting — and that loss cannot be made up in service hours.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb2_sk1_2_12.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名臥床長者每日臥床 12 小時，護理指引要求每 2 小時協助轉身一次。每日須協助轉身多少次？
hmb2_sk1_2_12.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A bed-bound resident spends 12 hours a day in bed and the care guideline requires repositioning every 2 hours. How many repositionings are needed each day?
hmb2_sk1_2_12.explanation:
次數 = $12 \div 2 = 6$ 次。定時轉身的目的是預防【壓瘡】：持續受壓的皮膚組織會因缺血而壞死，而一旦形成，治療需時數週至數月。這是預防成本遠低於治療成本的典型例子 —— 6 次轉身所需的人手，比一個壓瘡的護理少得多。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_sk1_2_12.explanationEn:
Repositionings = $12 \div 2 = 6$. Regular turning prevents PRESSURE ULCERS: skin under sustained pressure loses its blood supply and dies, and once an ulcer forms it takes weeks or months to heal. It is a textbook case of prevention costing far less than treatment — the staff time for 6 turns is a fraction of what one ulcer demands.

hmb2_pv1_1000_4000.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
某社區有 4000 名合資格居民，其中 1000 人接受了大腸癌篩查。篩查覆蓋率為多少百分比？
hmb2_pv1_1000_4000.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A community has 4000 eligible residents and 1000 took up colorectal cancer screening. What is the screening coverage, as a percentage?
hmb2_pv1_1000_4000.explanation:
覆蓋率 = $1000 \div 4000 \times 100\% = 25\%$。篩查屬【第二級預防】：疾病已經開始但尚未出現症狀，及早發現可大幅改善預後。第一級是預防疾病發生（疫苗、戒煙），第三級是已患病後減少失能（復康）。三級的分別不在於做甚麼，而在於【在疾病進程的哪一點介入】。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_pv1_1000_4000.explanationEn:
Coverage = $1000 \div 4000 \times 100\% = 25\%$. Screening is SECONDARY prevention: the disease has begun but has not yet declared itself, and early detection greatly improves the outlook. Primary prevention stops disease arising at all through vaccination or smoking cessation, while tertiary limits disability once disease is established. The three differ not in what is done but in WHERE ON THE DISEASE COURSE the intervention lands.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

A community has 8000 eligible residents and 1800 took up colorectal cancer screening. What is the screening coverage, as a percentage?
hmb2_pv1_1800_8000.explanation:
覆蓋率 = $1800 \div 8000 \times 100\% = 22.5\%$。篩查屬【第二級預防】：疾病已經開始但尚未出現症狀，及早發現可大幅改善預後。第一級是預防疾病發生（疫苗、戒煙），第三級是已患病後減少失能（復康）。三級的分別不在於做甚麼，而在於【在疾病進程的哪一點介入】。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_pv1_1800_8000.explanationEn:
Coverage = $1800 \div 8000 \times 100\% = 22.5\%$. Screening is SECONDARY prevention: the disease has begun but has not yet declared itself, and early detection greatly improves the outlook. Primary prevention stops disease arising at all through vaccination or smoking cessation, while tertiary limits disability once disease is established. The three differ not in what is done but in WHERE ON THE DISEASE COURSE the intervention lands.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

某社區有 10000 名合資格居民，其中 6000 人接受了大腸癌篩查。篩查覆蓋率為多少百分比？
hmb2_pv1_6000_10000.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A community has 10000 eligible residents and 6000 took up colorectal cancer screening. What is the screening coverage, as a percentage?
hmb2_pv1_6000_10000.explanation:
覆蓋率 = $6000 \div 10000 \times 100\% = 60\%$。篩查屬【第二級預防】：疾病已經開始但尚未出現症狀，及早發現可大幅改善預後。第一級是預防疾病發生（疫苗、戒煙），第三級是已患病後減少失能（復康）。三級的分別不在於做甚麼，而在於【在疾病進程的哪一點介入】。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_pv1_6000_10000.explanationEn:
Coverage = $6000 \div 10000 \times 100\% = 60\%$. Screening is SECONDARY prevention: the disease has begun but has not yet declared itself, and early detection greatly improves the outlook. Primary prevention stops disease arising at all through vaccination or smoking cessation, while tertiary limits disability once disease is established. The three differ not in what is done but in WHERE ON THE DISEASE COURSE the intervention lands.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb2_hc1_80_68.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
某地的預期壽命為 80 歲，健康預期壽命為 68 歲。平均而言，一個人有多少年在非完全健康的狀態下度過？
hmb2_hc1_80_68.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A territory has a life expectancy of 80 years and a healthy life expectancy of 68. On average, how many years are spent in less than full health?
hmb2_hc1_80_68.explanation:
$80 - 68 = 12$ 年。這個差距說明【長壽不等於健康】—— 醫療進步延長了生命，但若沒有同步延長健康年期，多出來的年份是在失能或長期病患之中度過。健康管理的目標因此不是把預期壽命推得更高，而是把兩條線之間的 12 年壓縮。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_hc1_80_68.explanationEn:
$80 - 68 = 12$ years. The gap shows that LONGER IS NOT HEALTHIER — medicine has extended life, but where healthy years have not kept pace the additional time is spent in disability or chronic illness. The aim of health management is therefore not to push life expectancy higher but to compress those 12 years between the two curves.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb2_et1_16_10.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一項研究向病人解釋 16 項治療資訊，事後測試顯示病人平均正確理解 10 項。理解率為多少百分比？
hmb2_et1_16_10.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A study explains 16 items of treatment information to patients, who afterwards recall 10 correctly on average. What is the comprehension rate, as a percentage?
hmb2_et1_16_10.explanation:
理解率 = $10 \div 16 \times 100\% = 62.5\%$。⚠️ 知情同意的成立條件是【理解】而非【告知】：簽署了同意書但只理解 62.5% 的資訊，在倫理上並不構成有效同意。這正是為何醫護要求病人【用自己的話複述】—— 覆述不出，就是未理解，而未理解的同意等於沒有同意。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_et1_16_10.explanationEn:
Comprehension = $10 \div 16 \times 100\% = 62.5\%$. NOTE that informed consent rests on UNDERSTANDING, not on having been told: a signed form covering 62.5% comprehension is not ethically valid consent. This is exactly why clinicians ask patients to REPEAT BACK in their own words — what cannot be restated has not been understood, and consent without understanding is not consent.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

一項研究向病人解釋 36 項治療資訊，事後測試顯示病人平均正確理解 20 項。理解率為多少百分比？
hmb2_et1_36_20.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A study explains 36 items of treatment information to patients, who afterwards recall 20 correctly on average. What is the comprehension rate, as a percentage?
hmb2_et1_36_20.explanation:
理解率 = $20 \div 36 \times 100\% = 55.6\%$。⚠️ 知情同意的成立條件是【理解】而非【告知】：簽署了同意書但只理解 55.6% 的資訊，在倫理上並不構成有效同意。這正是為何醫護要求病人【用自己的話複述】—— 覆述不出，就是未理解，而未理解的同意等於沒有同意。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_et1_36_20.explanationEn:
Comprehension = $20 \div 36 \times 100\% = 55.6\%$. NOTE that informed consent rests on UNDERSTANDING, not on having been told: a signed form covering 55.6% comprehension is not ethically valid consent. This is exactly why clinicians ask patients to REPEAT BACK in their own words — what cannot be restated has not been understood, and consent without understanding is not consent.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb2_ho1_12.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
整全健康評估涵蓋生理、心理、社交、情緒、精神與環境六個面向，各以五分為滿分。某人六項合計 12 分，其平均分為多少？
hmb2_ho1_12.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A holistic health assessment covers six dimensions — physical, mental, social, emotional, spiritual and environmental — each out of five. Someone scores 12 in total. What is their mean score?
hmb2_ho1_12.explanation:
平均 = $12 \div 6 = 2$ 分。⚠️ 整全健康【不可以只看平均】：五項滿分而一項零分，平均是 4.17 分，看似不錯，但那零分的一項（例如社交完全孤立）足以拖垮其餘五項。評估的用意正是找出【最弱的一環】，而平均數恰恰把它藏起來。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_ho1_12.explanationEn:
Mean = $12 \div 6 = 2$. NOTE that holistic health must NOT be read as an average: five perfect scores and one zero average 4.17, which looks respectable, yet that single zero — complete social isolation, say — will drag the other five down. The point of the assessment is to find the WEAKEST dimension, and an average is precisely what hides it.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

整全健康評估涵蓋生理、心理、社交、情緒、精神與環境六個面向，各以五分為滿分。某人六項合計 20 分，其平均分為多少？
hmb2_ho1_20.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A holistic health assessment covers six dimensions — physical, mental, social, emotional, spiritual and environmental — each out of five. Someone scores 20 in total. What is their mean score?
hmb2_ho1_20.explanation:
平均 = $20 \div 6 = 3.33$ 分。⚠️ 整全健康【不可以只看平均】：五項滿分而一項零分，平均是 4.17 分，看似不錯，但那零分的一項（例如社交完全孤立）足以拖垮其餘五項。評估的用意正是找出【最弱的一環】，而平均數恰恰把它藏起來。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_ho1_20.explanationEn:
Mean = $20 \div 6 = 3.33$. NOTE that holistic health must NOT be read as an average: five perfect scores and one zero average 4.17, which looks respectable, yet that single zero — complete social isolation, say — will drag the other five down. The point of the assessment is to find the WEAKEST dimension, and an average is precisely what hides it.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb2_ls1_50_600.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
某地區 65 歲及以上人口有 50 萬人，總人口 600 萬人。長者人口比例為多少百分比？
hmb2_ls1_50_600.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A territory has 50 × 10⁴ people aged 65 or above out of 600 × 10⁴ in total. What percentage are older persons?
hmb2_ls1_50_600.explanation:
比例 = $50 \div 600 \times 100\% = 8.3\%$。國際上一般以 7% 為「高齡化社會」、14% 為「高齡社會」、20% 為「超高齡社會」。⚠️ 比例上升可以來自兩個方向：長者增加，或者【出生人數下跌】。兩者對政策的含意不同 —— 前者要加照顧服務，後者要同時處理勞動人口萎縮。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_ls1_50_600.explanationEn:
Share = $50 \div 600 \times 100\% = 8.3\%$. Internationally 7% marks an "ageing society", 14% an "aged society" and 20% a "super-aged" one. NOTE the share can rise from either direction: more older people, or FEWER BIRTHS. The policy implications differ — the first calls for more care services, the second additionally for a shrinking workforce.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

A territory has 80 × 10⁴ people aged 65 or above out of 1000 × 10⁴ in total. What percentage are older persons?
hmb2_ls1_80_1000.explanation:
比例 = $80 \div 1000 \times 100\% = 8\%$。國際上一般以 7% 為「高齡化社會」、14% 為「高齡社會」、20% 為「超高齡社會」。⚠️ 比例上升可以來自兩個方向：長者增加，或者【出生人數下跌】。兩者對政策的含意不同 —— 前者要加照顧服務，後者要同時處理勞動人口萎縮。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_ls1_80_1000.explanationEn:
Share = $80 \div 1000 \times 100\% = 8\%$. Internationally 7% marks an "ageing society", 14% an "aged society" and 20% a "super-aged" one. NOTE the share can rise from either direction: more older people, or FEWER BIRTHS. The policy implications differ — the first calls for more care services, the second additionally for a shrinking workforce.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb2_ls1_120_750.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A territory has 120 × 10⁴ people aged 65 or above out of 750 × 10⁴ in total. What percentage are older persons?
hmb2_ls1_120_750.explanation:
比例 = $120 \div 750 \times 100\% = 16\%$。國際上一般以 7% 為「高齡化社會」、14% 為「高齡社會」、20% 為「超高齡社會」。⚠️ 比例上升可以來自兩個方向：長者增加，或者【出生人數下跌】。兩者對政策的含意不同 —— 前者要加照顧服務，後者要同時處理勞動人口萎縮。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_ls1_120_750.explanationEn:
Share = $120 \div 750 \times 100\% = 16\%$. Internationally 7% marks an "ageing society", 14% an "aged society" and 20% a "super-aged" one. NOTE the share can rise from either direction: more older people, or FEWER BIRTHS. The policy implications differ — the first calls for more care services, the second additionally for a shrinking workforce.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
某地區 65 歲及以上人口有 180 萬人，總人口 500 萬人。長者人口比例為多少百分比？
hmb2_ls1_180_500.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A territory has 180 × 10⁴ people aged 65 or above out of 500 × 10⁴ in total. What percentage are older persons?
hmb2_ls1_180_500.explanation:
比例 = $180 \div 500 \times 100\% = 36\%$。國際上一般以 7% 為「高齡化社會」、14% 為「高齡社會」、20% 為「超高齡社會」。⚠️ 比例上升可以來自兩個方向：長者增加，或者【出生人數下跌】。兩者對政策的含意不同 —— 前者要加照顧服務，後者要同時處理勞動人口萎縮。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_ls1_180_500.explanationEn:
Share = $180 \div 500 \times 100\% = 36\%$. Internationally 7% marks an "ageing society", 14% an "aged society" and 20% a "super-aged" one. NOTE the share can rise from either direction: more older people, or FEWER BIRTHS. The policy implications differ — the first calls for more care services, the second additionally for a shrinking workforce.

hmb2_pr1_25_12.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
某年某疾病在一個 12 千人的高危群組中新增 25 宗個案。該年的發病率為每萬人多少宗？
hmb2_pr1_25_12.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In one year 25 new cases arise in an at-risk group of 12 thousand. What is the incidence, per ten thousand people?
hmb2_pr1_25_12.explanation:
發病率 = $25 \div 12000 \times 10000 = 20.8$ 宗／萬人。⚠️ 發病率與【盛行率】不同：發病率只數【新增】個案，量度的是疾病發生的速度；盛行率數所有【現存】個案，量度的是負擔總量。一種可治癒的急性病發病率可以很高而盛行率很低，一種不可逆的慢性病則相反。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_pr1_25_12.explanationEn:
Incidence = $25 \div 12000 \times 10000 = 20.8$ per ten thousand. NOTE incidence differs from PREVALENCE: incidence counts only NEW cases and measures how fast disease arises, while prevalence counts all EXISTING cases and measures the burden carried. A curable acute illness can show high incidence with low prevalence; an irreversible chronic one shows the reverse.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

某年某疾病在一個 50 千人的高危群組中新增 48 宗個案。該年的發病率為每萬人多少宗？
hmb2_pr1_48_50.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In one year 48 new cases arise in an at-risk group of 50 thousand. What is the incidence, per ten thousand people?
hmb2_pr1_48_50.explanation:
發病率 = $48 \div 50000 \times 10000 = 9.6$ 宗／萬人。⚠️ 發病率與【盛行率】不同：發病率只數【新增】個案，量度的是疾病發生的速度；盛行率數所有【現存】個案，量度的是負擔總量。一種可治癒的急性病發病率可以很高而盛行率很低，一種不可逆的慢性病則相反。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_pr1_48_50.explanationEn:
Incidence = $48 \div 50000 \times 10000 = 9.6$ per ten thousand. NOTE incidence differs from PREVALENCE: incidence counts only NEW cases and measures how fast disease arises, while prevalence counts all EXISTING cases and measures the burden carried. A curable acute illness can show high incidence with low prevalence; an irreversible chronic one shows the reverse.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb2_ph1_500_1100.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
某社區 1100 人之中有 500 人已完成接種。接種率為多少百分比？
hmb2_ph1_500_1100.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In a community of 1100, 500 have completed vaccination. What is the vaccination rate, as a percentage?
hmb2_ph1_500_1100.explanation:
接種率 = $500 \div 1100 \times 100\% = 45.5\%$。群體免疫的門檻視乎疾病的傳染力而定：麻疹傳染力極強，需約 95% 才能阻斷傳播；季節性流感的門檻低得多。⚠️ 群體免疫保護的是【不能接種的人】—— 嬰兒、免疫缺損者。接種率不足時，最先受害的是他們，而不是選擇不接種的人。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_ph1_500_1100.explanationEn:
Vaccination rate = $500 \div 1100 \times 100\% = 45.5\%$. The herd-immunity threshold depends on how transmissible the disease is: measles is so infectious that about 95% is needed to stop spread, while seasonal influenza sits far lower. NOTE herd immunity protects THOSE WHO CANNOT BE VACCINATED — infants and the immunocompromised. When coverage falls short they are harmed first, not those who declined.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

某社區 1250 人之中有 500 人已完成接種。接種率為多少百分比？
hmb2_ph1_500_1250.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In a community of 1250, 500 have completed vaccination. What is the vaccination rate, as a percentage?
hmb2_ph1_500_1250.explanation:
接種率 = $500 \div 1250 \times 100\% = 40\%$。群體免疫的門檻視乎疾病的傳染力而定：麻疹傳染力極強，需約 95% 才能阻斷傳播；季節性流感的門檻低得多。⚠️ 群體免疫保護的是【不能接種的人】—— 嬰兒、免疫缺損者。接種率不足時，最先受害的是他們，而不是選擇不接種的人。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_ph1_500_1250.explanationEn:
Vaccination rate = $500 \div 1250 \times 100\% = 40\%$. The herd-immunity threshold depends on how transmissible the disease is: measles is so infectious that about 95% is needed to stop spread, while seasonal influenza sits far lower. NOTE herd immunity protects THOSE WHO CANNOT BE VACCINATED — infants and the immunocompromised. When coverage falls short they are harmed first, not those who declined.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

hmb2_sk2_125_2_3.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一名長者的處方為每次 125 毫克、每日 2 次、服用 3 日。整個療程合共服用多少毫克？
hmb2_sk2_125_2_3.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A prescription reads 125 mg per dose, 2 times daily, for 3 days. What is the total dose over the whole course, in mg?
hmb2_sk2_125_2_3.explanation:
總劑量 = $125 \times 2 \times 3 = 750$ 毫克。⚠️ 照顧者最常見的用藥錯誤不是算錯總量，而是【自行停藥】：症狀消失就停，療程未完。抗生素尤其如此 —— 未殺盡的細菌會留下抗藥性較強的一群，下次再病就更難治。療程訂為 3 日，就是 3 日。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_sk2_125_2_3.explanationEn:
Total dose = $125 \times 2 \times 3 = 750$ mg. NOTE the commonest medication error among carers is not miscalculation but STOPPING EARLY once symptoms ease. With antibiotics this matters most — the bacteria that survive are the more resistant ones, and the next infection is harder to treat. A 3-day course means 3 days.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.

一名長者的處方為每次 125 毫克、每日 3 次、服用 7 日。整個療程合共服用多少毫克？
hmb2_sk2_125_3_7.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A prescription reads 125 mg per dose, 3 times daily, for 7 days. What is the total dose over the whole course, in mg?
hmb2_sk2_125_3_7.explanation:
總劑量 = $125 \times 3 \times 7 = 2625$ 毫克。⚠️ 照顧者最常見的用藥錯誤不是算錯總量，而是【自行停藥】：症狀消失就停，療程未完。抗生素尤其如此 —— 未殺盡的細菌會留下抗藥性較強的一群，下次再病就更難治。療程訂為 7 日，就是 7 日。

【全庫升級】干擾項與題幹改為雙重條件判別；df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10（意圖）。非實測難 10%。
hmb2_sk2_125_3_7.explanationEn:
Total dose = $125 \times 3 \times 7 = 2625$ mg. NOTE the commonest medication error among carers is not miscalculation but STOPPING EARLY once symptoms ease. With antibiotics this matters most — the bacteria that survive are the more resistant ones, and the next infection is harder to treat. A 7-day course means 7 days.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition stem; DSE_PLUS_10 intent only.
